Nyout (유놓이 / Yut Nori)

Korean stick-throwing race across a circular track. Throw four sticks to generate movement values. Race tokens around a circular track with shortcut branches. Capture opponent tokens to send them back to start. Stack tokens for combined movement but risk losing multiple at once. First team to move all tokens home wins.

1 Variants
race Plugin
✓ Frontmatter-only

Declared, Not Coded

Every rule of Nyout (유놓이 / Yut Nori) below is frontmatter in the rules corpus, played by the race plugin. The board beside each is the game itself, live.

Nyout (Standard) Rules

Throw four sticks to generate movement values. Race tokens around a circular track with shortcut branches. Capture opponent tokens to send them back to start. Stack tokens for combined movement but risk losing multiple at once. First team to move all tokens home wins.

engine:
  topology:
    type: graph
    structure: perimeter-cross
  players: [white, black]
  plugin: race
  plugins:
    nyout:
      pieces: 4
      routes:
        outer: [n2, n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n9, n10, n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n1…
        first: [n6, n29, n28, n21, n27, n26, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20]
        second: [n11, n22, n23, n21, n24, n25]
        centre: [n21, n24, n25]
      seatRoutes: outer
      shortcuts:
        - at: n6
          take: first
        - at: n11
          take: second
        - at: n21
          take: centre
      throw:
        lots: 4
        scores:
          0: 5
  # …
